description: A host's telemetry over a stretch: its chat events, its samples, its line profiles, and its turns added up, its errors, its processes' counts (each minute's, or added up); its telemetry state with it. Any member of the mesh may ask any other: one machine pulls every host's and puts them together by their times.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

from.description: From, in seconds since the epoch.

limit.description: The most events, samples and profiles each (the latest kept; default 5000).
